accountScope: The CLI's existing sign-in on the probing machine. No identity is recorded.

completeness.meaning: The command lists what the picker offers; an absent row still needs picker confirmation before removal.

stillNeedsPicker: A model (default) marker, picker descriptions, picker order, and every field not listed under authoritativeFor still need picker evidence.

redaction.method: Projected public model fields only; no raw output, account identifier, price, endpoint or login text. String values passed through the skill redaction helper.
redaction.reviewBeforeCommit: Check names, paths and provider-specific identifiers by hand; the helper catches only common shapes.
